note: Escambia County AL has no county-level zoning (Code of Alabama Chapter 27 zoning article reserved; parcelvision says no county zoning). The county GIS viewer (escambia.alabamagis.com) exposes no zoning layer. The two incorporated cities that zone, Brewton and Atmore, publish their zoning maps only as PDF files (Brewton-Zoning-Map-11-17-16.pdf; Atmore Zoning Map PDF on cityofatmore.gov), with no queryable ArcGIS service found. ArcGIS search returned no Escambia AL zoning service.
